text:
ana: Heads-up — QuantumEdge reached out asking to onboard a new GCP region (gcp-ap-southwest2) into the marketplace. They need entitlement + quota for a dedicated k8s SKU and a backup NVL GPU pool. partner contact is Jordan from QuantumEdge (cc'd via partner portal).

mike: thanks Ana. do we have capacity estimates from QE? rough vGPU hours / monthly commits?

ana: they submitted a spreadsheet in the portal but tl;dr: 1500 vGPU hours/mo baseline, spike to 5k for marketing launch. prefer reserved monthly commit with burst to shared pool. link: https://redwood.internal/partners/qe/onboard-2026 (portal token required).

lina: noted. two things from infra side: 1) need quota ticket to GCP marketplace for the new SKU 2) confirm KMS and billing mapping (customer will use marketplace billing). I'll file the quota request once we have final SKU name & commit.

mike: Jordan asked for an approximate lead time. what should we tell them?

lina: if quotas are standard, 7-10 business days for marketplace entitlement + 3-5 days to provision dedicated nodepool and KMS bindings. but that assumes no special approvals.

ana: Jordan also asked about a joint announcement window (they want launch week of May 11). that's aggressive. can we hit it?

evan: legal: we need to run the partner MSA addendum for marketplace co-sell. I'll start the review but need the product description & data flow (what customer data touches our control plane). Ana — can you paste the short SOW text here?

ana: SOW snippet: "Redwood will enable QuantumEdge to offer a dedicated k8s SKU via GCP Marketplace with isolated compute and optional NVL GPU burst. Redwood will manage entitlement, quotas, and KMS integration; QuantumEdge is responsible for their marketplace listing metadata and support."

mike: putting dependencies here:
- infra (lina): quota ticket + nodepool provisioning
- legal (evan): MSA addendum + announcement wording
- partnerships (mike/ana): commercial commit and launch date
- eng-sre (sre-ops): runbook for failover to shared pool

sre-ops: can do a short runbook. need the exact fallback SKU and expected latency impact. also want a canary plan for the first 72 hrs.

lina: creating quota ticket now. ticket: GCP-MP-2026-6743. ETA to vendor (GCP PM) 8 business days. attaching initial quota payload:
```json
{
  "sku": "qe-dedicated-k8s-v1",
  "region": "ap-southwest2",
  "requested_vgpu_hours": 5000
}
```

ana: Jordan — FYI we've kicked off the infra ticket and legal review. I'll loop you back once MSA draft is ready. Can you confirm the committed monthly vGPU baseline (1500 or upgrade to 2k)?

deploy-bot: [deployment note] marketplace quota ticket GCP-MP-2026-6743 created by lina. status: open.

mike: Jordan replied in portal: can confirm 2k baseline, 5k burst. asks if we can reserve burst from shared pool or if it needs dedicated capacity.

lina: we can support burst from shared pool but need to enable routing policy and set throttles. that requires a policy change in the console (ops runbook). I'll draft the change and post the config snippet.

evan: I'll aim to have MSA addendum draft in 48 hours. send me the launch marketing blurb and any claims about latency/SLA.

ana: putting tentative timelines:
- legal draft: +2 days
- quota approval: ~8 business days
- infra provisioning: 3-5 days after approval
- SRE runbook & canary: 2 days
- partner marketing assets: partner to provide by Apr 28

mike: thanks team. next step: Lina to update ticket with final SKU and commit (2k). Evan will post legal draft when ready. I'll sync with Jordan and aim to lock launch date after quota approval. :thumbsup:

sre-ops: noted, will prepare canary checklist and fallback scripts. please tag me when quota is approved so I can schedule the 72hr canary window.

ana: great — closing the loop here. I'll follow up with Jordan and post updates in this thread. :eyes:
